properties.Program_Description: Big Brothers Big Sisters of Colorado makes meaningful monitored matches between adult volunteers (“Bigs”) and children (“Littles”) ages nine through young adulthood in Colorado.; Bigs and Littles participate in agency-supervised and organized match activities including attending and playing team sports.
properties.Registration_Process: First step is to fill this out online: https://www.biglittlecolorado.org/enroll-a-child/apply/Our staff will then get in touch about setting up an interview to meet you and your child so that we can learn more about you and your family, so that we can make the best 'match' for your child.
